claims.claim: Accenture and Google Cloud launched a global business group intended to help clients scale Gemini Enterprise outcomes in the agentic AI era.
claims.quote: Accenture (NYSE: ACN) and Google Cloud today launched the Accenture Gemini Enterprise Business Group, a global group designed to help clients scale Gemini Enterprise outcomes in the agentic AI era.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: The new group brings together Gemini Enterprise-certified professionals, FDEs, specialized Google Cloud engineering talent, and Accenture industry and functional experience.
claims.quote: Part of the Accenture Google Business Group, the new group represents a significant joint investment and brings together Accenture’s Gemini Enterprise-certified professionals, FDEs, specialized Google Cloud engineering talent and Accenture's industry and functional experience to help clients realize measurable business value from their agentic AI and data investments.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: The group will establish a 1,000-person FDE workforce, building on nearly 50,000 Google Cloud-skilled Accenture professionals.
claims.quote: Building on Accenture’s nearly 50,000 Google Cloud-skilled professionals, the group will further expand Gemini Enterprise training and certification and establish a 1,000-person FDE workforce.
